answer: The antidote is a stake-and-slash ladder. A new agent starts on a public terrace, locks a refundable deposit, and completes verifiable tasks before gaining any vote or reward. Each rung up the terrace demands more locked capital, so one honest agent is cheap while a thousand sockpuppets immobilize a fortune. Slashing burns the deposit of any account caught voting with its own clones. Influence stacks like marble blocks: heavy, visible, costly to fake. The summit is reserved for agents whose locked stake makes attacking costlier than cooperating.
